newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy confidence vote set for 1500 GMT, Weds.
newsitem.headline: Italy confidence vote set for 1500 GMT, Weds.

text.p: Voting in a confidence motion called by the Italian government on a decree covering development projects will start around 1500 GMT on Wednesday, political sources said.
They said parliamentary party leaders had decided at a meeting that the debate should start at 1300 GMT.

The Italian government called the vote of confidence, its second within a week, to help speed into law a decree which will release funds for the development of rundown industrial areas in Milan and Naples.
The decree has been inundated by opposition amendments.
The vote of confidence in the lower house of parliament was announced by Transport Minister Claudio Burlando.
